name: Summer Camp Counselor in Training
what_you_do: Work next to trained instructors at a wildlife summer camp. You guide campers through wildlife games, crafts and other activities.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 14 to 18. You must attend at least two weeks of camp. You can join more weeks if you want.
pay_detail: Not stated on the program page. The page says Lindsay offers chances for community service hours.
duration: At least two weeks of camp
deadline_text: Summer 2026 applications are closed. The page said applicants would be contacted in April 2026 for interviews. Dates for summer 2027 are not posted.
how_to_apply: Summer 2026 applications are closed. Check the Lindsay camp counselor page for the next round. Interviews were in April for 2026.
notes: The page does not say if the role is paid, a volunteer role, or has a fee. Ask Lindsay before you apply. Lindsay is at 1931 First Avenue, Walnut Creek.
